title: 403 Forbidden when calling /api/v2/datasets with a service token
body: My service account token works for `GET /api/v2/datasets` but `POST` returns `403 Forbidden`. What permission is missing?
author: asker

answers.body:
The token needs the `dataset-writer` role. Grant it with:

```bash
orbitctl role grant --subject svc-ingest --role dataset-writer
```

Reads only need `dataset-reader`.
answers.author: dana
